description: This file contains unit tests for Orleans one-way method calls, verifying their synchronous return behavior both from clients and grains, including specific tests for Task and ValueTask variants, and observing side effects and exceptions.

classes.name: OneWayCallTests
classes.description: Test class for Orleans one-way method call behaviors, including synchronous completion and grain-to-grain communication.

classes.name: SimpleGrainObserver
classes.description: A private nested class implementing ISimpleGrainObserver to observe and signal received messages during tests.

methods.name: OneWayMethodsReturnSynchronously_ViaClient
methods.description: Test that Orleans one-way methods invoked from a client complete synchronously and execute properly.

methods.name: OneWayMethodReturnSynchronously_ViaGrain
methods.description: Test that grain-to-grain one-way calls complete synchronously and observe expected side effects.

methods.name: OneWayMethodsReturnSynchronously_ViaClient_ValueTask
methods.description: Verifies that ValueTask-based one-way calls from client to grain complete synchronously as expected.

methods.name: OneWayMethodReturnSynchronously_ViaGrain_ValueTask
methods.description: Verifies that grain-to-grain ValueTask-based one-way calls complete synchronously.
